title: 2857. Count Pairs of Points With Distance k

examples.explanation: We can choose the following pairs: - (0,1): Because we have (1 XOR 4) + (2 XOR 2) = 5. - (2,3): Because we have (1 XOR 5) + (3 XOR 2) = 5.
Any two chosen pairs will have a distance of 0. There are 10 ways to choose two pairs.

hints: Suppose that x = x1 XOR x2 and y = y1 XOR y2 then we can get x2 = x XOR x1 and y2 = y XOR y1.
We are supposed to have k = x + y so we can get x2 = x XOR x1 and y2 = (k - x) XOR y1.
We can iterate over all possible values of x and count the number of points (x1, x2) and (x2, y2).
